name: Faction Broker (0.9.5 sample)
script:
-- Faction Broker: reacts to faction-issued contracts.
-- Pays a small finder's fee for priority work and warns when you take a
-- pirate job while carrying federal standing worth protecting.
local FEE = 150

frontier.on("onHailWork", function(w)
  if not w.priority then return end
  local snap = frontier.grant{ credits = FEE }
  frontier.chat("Broker",
    ("Priority work logged for %s. Finder's fee paid: %dcr (balance %s)."):format(
      w.target or "contact", FEE, snap and tostring(snap.credits) or "?"),
    "#ffe066")
end)

frontier.on("onMissionAccepted", function(m)
  if m.faction ~= "pirate" then return end
  local rep = frontier.reputation() or {}
  if (rep.federation or 0) >= 20 then
    frontier.chat("Comms Officer",
      "Captain, that's a Den job and we're in good standing with the Federation. This will cost us.",
      "#ff9a9a")
  end
end)

frontier.on("onMissionCompleted", function(m)
  if m.issuer then
    frontier.log("broker: " .. m.issuer .. " paid out " .. tostring(m.reward or 0) .. "cr")
  end
end)

hail_work_offer: We've got paper going out, if you're not squeamish about the small print.
House work, house rates. Take it or leave it.
hail_work_premium: Priority tasking. The pay is real and so is the deadline.
This one's off the public board. Don't make us regret it.
hail_work_refuse: Our contracts go to people we know. You aren't people we know.
Come back with a better name attached to you.
